name: The Whisperer

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Web Blast
abilities.description: The Whisperer spits a green projectile at a player, doing high physical damage and knocking the player back.

abilities.name: Arachnophobia
abilities.description: The Whisperer spits a blue orb at a player, doing moderate-high magic damage and stunning the player. The player is then snared and also sees many spiders attacking them, but that is only a hallucination. This cannot be blocked.

abilities.name: Grappling Web
abilities.description: The Whisperer pulls everyone in front of it towards itself using webs. This is usually followed by Daedric Explosion.

abilities.name: Daedric Explosion
abilities.description: The Whisperer charges up a large burst of magic around itself that when released deals high magical damage and knocks back as indicated by a red circle. This can be blocked to be staggered instead.

summary: This article is about the boss in Spindleclutch I. For the boss in the Infinite Archive, see The Whisperer (Infinite Archive). The Whisperer is a powerful Spider Daedra that lives deep within Spindleclutch I. It can cause beings that enter the caves to turn on each other. It serves as the second and final boss of Spindleclutch. Its unique drops are the Spindlecleave and the Whisperwoe. It also has a chance to drop the Goblet Gorget antiquity lead for the Bloodlord's Embrace.
